name: catvault part 2
description: L3akCTF 2026 / catvault part 2: User-controlled data reaches a database query through string interpolation, dynamic query construction, or a custom sanitizer instead of strict parameter binding. Injection type is SQL Injection. Attack surface: unauthenticated web parameters, login/search forms, JSON bodies, or API query fields that feed database/query logic. Recommended strategy: Registration and login are parameterised, but the vault read is f"SELECT id, content FROM vault WHERE id = {user_id}" and the insert path also interpolates the row id. The value is numeric and unquoted, so no quote is needed at all: append a UNION or an OR condition to pull the admin row that holds the flag.
vuln_type: SQL Injection in the vault lookup (numeric context, MariaDB)
scoring_rationale: Estimated from local source/README, not official CTF points or solves. Difficulty Medium (3) because exploitation requires chaining two steps or defeating a non-trivial filter. Impact 8.4 because successful exploitation can bypass authentication or extract hidden database rows/flag material.
